newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil postpones deadline on rail privatization.
newsitem.headline: Brazil postpones deadline on rail privatization.

text.p: Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) said it postponed until next Tuesday the deadline for investors to sign up for the auction of the southeast section of the country's federal railway network.
Investors were previously required to sign up by Friday.
The BNDES decided to postpone the deadline to give investors more time to organize their consortia, a BNDES spokesman said.

The 1,674 km southeast stretch, which comprises mainly track in the states of Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, will be auctioned on September 20 on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ).
The southeast section will be the third of the railway's six stretches included in the country's privatization program.
Earlier this year, Brazil sold the concessions to operate the center-east and west sections.
